definitions.explanation: The material forming the inner core of a layered or composite structure. Used in construction, manufacturing, and materials science to describe the central structural component.
The dense, dark inner wood of a tree trunk, as opposed to the lighter sapwood on the outside. Heartwood is valued in woodworking for its durability and color.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{芯|しん}→芯：03888_shin⟧ (core) and ⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (material/wood). The word has two distinct domains: in manufacturing it means core material in a composite structure, and in forestry/woodworking it means the dark inner wood of a tree.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芯材|しんざい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{表面材|ひょうめんざい}: core and surface material
- {芯材|しんざい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{辺材|へんざい}: heartwood and sapwood
- ⟦{断熱|だんねつ}→断熱：06427_dannetsu⟧{芯材|しんざい}: insulation core material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {心材|しんざい}: heartwood (alternate kanji, same meaning in the forestry sense)
- {辺材|へんざい}: sapwood (the lighter outer wood, opposite of heartwood)
- {基材|きざい}: base material; substrate
